name: T-Mobile Project 10Million
description: Free mobile hotspot device for income-eligible households with K-12 students with 200GB high-speed data per year for 5 years; optional $10/10GB data pass available when data limit is reached; free Web Guard content filtering
fullDescription: T-Mobile Project 10Million is an initiative to provide free internet connectivity to underserved K-12 student households across the U.S., helping close the homework gap.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free mobile hotspot device (one per household)
- 200GB high-speed data per year for 5 years
- No fees, costs, or annual re-certifications
- Free Web Guard content filtering for safety
- Optional $10 data pass for additional 10GB when needed
howToGetIt:
1. Household must have a K-12 student
2. Student must be eligible for the National School Lunch Program, SNAP/EBT, Community Eligibility Provision, Medicaid, or FDPIR
3. Parents apply online at T-Mobile's Project 10Million page (or get help at a T-Mobile store)
4. Upload proof of enrollment in a qualifying program dated within the past year
5. Sign the service agreement; the hotspot ships free in about 3-5 business days
keywords: T-Mobile, Project 10Million, free hotspot, student internet, homework gap, K-12, school lunch program, free WiFi, mobile hotspot, low-income student, digital divide
